Compare rows by position rather than by value

Source: R/resolve-columns.R
daffiz_row_number.Rd

Pass as by to compare_dt() to align rows by their position in each input instead of by the value of identity columns. Positional comparison must be requested explicitly; it is never inferred (design plan section 4.2).

daffiz_row_number()

Value

A sentinel recognized by compare_dt().

Examples

x <- data.frame(v = c(1, 2, 3))
y <- data.frame(v = c(1, 2, 3.5))
compare_dt(x, y, by = daffiz_row_number())
#> daffiz comparison: x -> y
#> Rows: 3 / 3 | numeric measures: 1 | compared cells: 3
#> Result: 1 non-equal cell(s) in 1 row(s) across 1 measure(s)
#> Identity (explicit): .position
#> Measures (inferred): v
#> Tolerance: abs 0 | rel 0
#> 
#> Measures with differences
#>    column n_diff n_x_only n_y_only fraction_diff max_abs_diff
#>    <char>  <int>    <int>    <int>         <num>        <num>
#> 1:      v      1        0        0     0.3333333          0.5
#> 
#> Rows with differences
#>    .row_x .row_y row_type n_diff diff_columns max_abs_diff
#>     <int>  <int>   <fctr>  <int>       <char>        <num>
#> 1:      3      3     diff      1            v          0.5
#> 
#> Example cells
#> Key: <.position, .metric>
#>    .position .row_x .row_y .metric .value_x .value_y .diff .match_type
#>        <int>  <int>  <int>  <char>    <num>    <num> <num>      <fctr>
#> 1:         3      3      3       v        3      3.5  -0.5        diff
